editorial:
Imagine a universe where everything is finally peaceful, only for your favorite space heroes to start fighting each other. You get dropped into a world where Hammie has suddenly turned into a fugitive after stealing a powerful new gadget called the Neo Kyutama. It feels like a wild cosmic chase because Lucky and his crew are split right down the middle. Some trust Hammie, while others follow President Tsurugi's orders to hunt her down. To make things even crazier, you get the legendary Space Sheriffs Gavan and Shaider jumping into the mix, which adds a huge layer of nostalgia and cool energy to the whole vibe.

The action is loud, colorful, and fast, which is exactly what you want from a movie like this. You will love the flashy fight scenes and the funny banter between the characters. While the plot moves a bit too quickly at times, the chemistry between the Kyurangers and the Space Squad keeps you hooked. If you want the best experience, you should definitely grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see those bright colors pop. Or, if you prefer digital, renting it on Apple TV is a great way to enjoy the spectacle with your friends.
endingExplained: You find out that Hammie didn't steal the Neo Kyutama to be evil. She actually did it to protect the universe from a hidden threat. After a massive battle where the Kyurangers and Space Sheriffs team up, they defeat the real villains together. The rift between the friends is healed, and Tsurugi admits he was wrong. Everything wraps up with a big celebration, proving that trust and friendship are stronger than any space weapon.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves colorful heroes and space adventures.
